{{RV|type=command

|game1= arma3
|version1= 1.72

|gr1= Custom Panels

|descr= Returns array all info panels configured for given object or object and turret path.

|s1= [[infoPanels]] unit

|p1= unit: [[Object]] - the concerned vehicle

|r1= [[Array]] - format [<nowiki/>[infoPanelId1, infoPanelShortcutId1], [infoPanelId2, infoPanelShortcutId2], ...]:
* infoPanelId: [[String]] - name of the info panel class as defined in vehicle config
* infopanelShortcutId: [[String]] - shortcut representation of ''infopanelId'', currently are supported only shortcuts "left" and "right"

|s2= [[infoPanels]] [unit, turretPath]

|p21= unit: [[Object]] - the concerned vehicle

|p22= turretPath: [[Turret Path]] - turret index

|r2= [[Array]] - format [<nowiki/>[infoPanelId1, infoPanelShortcutId1], [infoPanelId2, infoPanelShortcutId2], ...]:
* infoPanelId: [[String]] - name of the info panel class as defined in vehicle config
* infopanelShortcutId: [[String]] - shortcut representation of ''infopanelId'', currently are supported only shortcuts "left" and "right"

|x1= <sqf>infoPanels [vehicle player, [0]];</sqf>

|seealso= [[Arma 3: Custom Info]] [[infoPanel]] [[setInfoPanel]] [[infoPanelComponents]] [[enableInfoPanelComponent]] [[infoPanelComponentEnabled]] [[openGPS]]
}}
